dedupe_keys.name: oecd affordable housing database ahd indicator hm1 5 residential stock by dwelling type detached semi detached flats other in oecd and eu countries

description: The OECD Affordable Housing Database gathers housing indicators for OECD and EU countries, and its indicator HM1.5 shows how the occupied dwelling stock splits into detached houses, semi-detached and terraced houses, flats and other accommodation. The indicator note read on 2026-09-28, last updated in October 2025, explains that the shares come mainly from the EU Statistics on Income and Living Conditions and from national statistical institutes, chiefly population and housing censuses, defines each dwelling type, and notes that most data refer to 2021, with 2020 for Mexico and Norway and 2018 for Iceland. Coverage is OECD and EU member countries. The note is free; the database's data files and licence were not read, as oecd.org pages serve a bot check to the cloud session. Caveats: dwelling type definitions differ slightly between countries, and the indicator gives national shares, not counts by area. It supports building exposure studies, such as weighting national building stock models by the share of flats and houses when estimating flood or earthquake damage, or comparing district heating potential across countries. No related OECD housing record is catalogued; the database's other indicators, for example on housing conditions and tenure, were not read.
